rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone irritatingly pleased with themselves.

example.english: You only guessed right once; no need to be so smug.
example.traditional: 你啱啱估中一次咋，唔使咁得戚喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 gu2 zung3 jat1 ci3 zaa3 m4 sai2 gam3 dak1 cik1 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the person's smugness is especially obvious and visibly triumphant.

example.english: After winning the prize, he spent the whole evening looking smug and showing off.
example.traditional: 攞完獎返嚟，佢成晚都得意洋洋咁周圍晒命。
example.jyutping: lo2 jyun4 zoeng2 faan1 lai4 keoi5 sing4 maan5 dou1 dak1 ji3 joeng4 joeng4 gam3 zau1 wai4 saai3 meng6
